description: Angular component for configuring 'Update Multiple Attributes' widget settings in Thingsboard UI, including form initialization, default settings, validation, and dynamic validator updates.

classes.name: UpdateMultipleAttributesWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending WidgetSettingsComponent to manage settings form for a specific widget.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically enables/disables form controls based on other control values.
